title: Simulating SBML models
text: sbml_odes() follows Level 3 Version 2 specification turn reactions rules states right-hand sides: species whose symbol amount changes stoichiometry times rate; one whose symbol concentration changes divided compartment’s size; reaction id stands rate, evaluated assignment; function definitions local parameters inlined. Events carried data:
code: eq <- sbml_odes(m) eq$states #>       name   symbol    kind #> 1 drug_gut drug_gut species #> 2     drug     drug species eq$rhs #> $drug_gut #> -absorption #>  #> $drug #> (absorption - elimination)/central eq$assignments #> $absorption #> ka * drug_gut #>  #> $elimination #> ke * drug * central eq$constants #>     gut central      ka      ke    dose  #>     1.0    10.0     1.0     0.2   100.0 sbml_initial_state(m) #> drug_gut     drug  #>      100        0 str(eq$events[[1]][c("id", "trigger", "assignments")]) #> List of 3 #>  $ id         : chr "second_dose" #>  $ trigger    : language time >= 12 #>  $ assignments:List of 1 #>   ..$ drug_gut: language drug_gut + dose

title: Simulating SBML models
text: sbml_derivs() returns derivative function deSolve calls, else needs attributes: y0, states time 0 events fire ; parms; , model events, rootfunc events. Use lsodar, deSolve method finds roots.  event engine applies SBML rules events: trigger fires changes false true; initialValue says time 0; delay postpones execution, non-persistent event canceled trigger turns false meanwhile; events due time run priority order, random order tied, set seed reproducible run.
code: f <- sbml_derivs(m, outputs = "absorption") out <- deSolve::ode(   y = attr(f, "y0"),   times = seq(0, 24, by = 0.25),   func = f,   parms = attr(f, "parms"),   method = "lsodar",   rootfunc = attr(f, "rootfunc"),   events = attr(f, "events") ) plot(out[, "time"], out[, "drug"], type = "l",      xlab = "Time (hours)", ylab = "Concentration in central")

title: Read, Write and Derive Equations from SBML Models
text: SBML, Systems Biology Markup Language, models biochemical networks, pharmacokinetics cell signaling shared: hundreds curated BioModels. SBML file describes reactions species compartments, solver wants dX/dt state. translation, amounts concentrations, compartments change size, conversion factors events, hand-written versions go wrong. R packages read SBML either need libSBML system library longer maintained. zusbml reads SBML document one R object, writes back SBML, derives equations solver needs, nothing R installed. Derivation point. sbml_odes() gives states, right-hand sides, assignments events R expressions; sbml_derivs() turns function deSolve, SBML’s event semantics (delays, priorities, persistence) included. Checked SBML Test Suite. 1,384 cases SBML Test Suite 3.5.0 within supported set reproduce reference results case’s tolerances. 308 Level 3 Version 2 cases use algebraic rules, delay, fast reactions SBML packages, refused name rather approximated. 1,028 supported cases also pass read Level 2 Version 5 file. Pure R. package zusbml imports zuxml, XML; system library install. Safe documents anywhere. Model math evaluated environment built fixed list base R functions, document can call function definitions, reach system() rest R. Round trips. Reading, writing reading gives identical model, every readable Test Suite case fifty curated BioModels.

title: Read, Write and Derive Equations from SBML Models
text: package comes small model drug taken mouth: absorbed gut central compartment, eliminated , dosed second time hour 12. sbml_read() takes file, URL XML . kind element data frame. drug gut amount; drug central compartment concentration. sbml_odes() derives equations. concentration’s right-hand side divided volume compartment, reaction id stands rate. sbml_derivs() gives deSolve needs, including event: drug gut goes back hour 12. sbml_write() writes SBML Level 3 Version 2, reading back gives model. sbml_to_rxode2() writes equations rxode2 model text. rxode2 text express SBML events, dose hour 12 refused unless ask dropped. Functions named sbml_*(): sbml_read() sbml_write() documents, accessor per element kind, sbml_odes(), sbml_derivs() sbml_to_rxode2() equations.
code: library(zusbml) m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "dosing.xml", package = "zusbml")) m #> <sbml_model 'dosing'> SBML Level 3 Version 2 #>   compartments  2 #>   species       2 #>   parameters    3 #>   reactions     2 #>   events        1 species <- sbml_species(m) species[, c("id", "compartment", "initial_amount", "has_only_substance_units")] #>         id compartment initial_amount has_only_substance_units #> 1 drug_gut         gut            100                     TRUE #> 2     drug     central              0                    FALSE eq <- sbml_odes(m) eq$rhs #> $drug_gut #> -absorption #>  #> $drug #> (absorption - elimination)/central eq$assignments #> $absorption #> ka * drug_gut #>  #> $elimination #> ke * drug * central f <- sbml_derivs(m) deSolve::ode(   attr(f, "y0"), times = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24), func = f, parms = attr(f, "parms"),   method = "lsodar", rootfunc = attr(f, "rootfunc"), events = attr(f, "events") ) #>   time     drug_gut     drug #> 1    0 1.000000e+02 0.000000 #> 2    6 2.478742e-01 3.733943 #> 3   12 1.000006e+02 1.133898 #> 4   18 2.478759e-01 4.075490 #> 5   24 6.144424e-04 1.236769 identical(sbml_read(sbml_write(m)), m) #> [1] TRUE cat(sbml_to_rxode2(m, events = "drop")) #> # dosing, written by zusbml from SBML Level 3 Version 2 #> gut = 1; #> central = 10; #> ka = 1; #> ke = 0.20000000000000001; #> dose = 100; #> drug_gut(0) = 100; #> drug(0) = 0; #> absorption = ka * drug_gut; #> elimination = ke * drug * central; #> d/dt(drug_gut) = -absorption; #> d/dt(drug) = (absorption - elimination)/central;
